text: Upon You have I relied and been sustained from my birth; You are He who took me from my mother's womb and You have been my benefactor from that day. My praise is continually of You.
Saying, "God has abandoned him; Pursue and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him."
I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD [and in His strength]; I will make mention of Your righteousness, Yours alone.
May You increase my greatness (honor) And turn to comfort me.
My tongue also will speak of Your righteousness all day long; For they are ashamed, for they are humiliated who seek my injury.
